notes.title: Demo Gameplay Update
notes.content: [h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed the issue where the Robot material displays abnormally under lighting conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a rotation threshold limit for the heads of all objects that can gaze at the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem where teleporting enemies occasionally teleport to the opposite corridor, blocking the player from moving after they choose a door.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug in the [i]DarkMover[/i] level where the player's perspective might fail to recover from the dark effect after choosing a door.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the rabbit in the [i]WindowsRabbitHead[/i] event had no sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem where the original robots remained in the [i]Wellcome[/i] level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the door used to cover flaws in [i]TruthTwo[/i] was not hidden.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the unlocalized audio issue of "Dad found me" in [i]TruthOne[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved the clipping problem caused by the disappearance of space when the player enters the door backward in the corridor.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved the issue where quitting the game directly without clicking the Return button at the end would result in entering the third loop upon re-entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved the issue where the progress was not reset when quickly clicking return after dying and entering the death room.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Updates[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Adjusted the difficulty of the [i]OneTwoThree[/i] level.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the difficulty of the [i]InvisibleFollower[/i] level.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the material appearance of DarkMover to distinguish it from other types of robots.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the material of ordinary robots (the original material was too dark).[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the [i]RedLightGreenLight[/i] level:[/p][list][*][p]Added sound effect prompts for light switching;[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the robot's start-up delay;[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the level difficulty.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted the door opening logic: the player's view will automatically align forward, and it is no longer required to "look at the door" to unlock it.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended the light flickering time and reduced the difficulty of the [i]DarkMover[/i] level.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Gameplay Update
notes.content: [h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the bug in the [i]ChooseDoor[/i] level where the door required repeated triggering to open due to issues with the player's 视野判定 (field of view detection).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue in linear levels where the door would disappear if the player quickly turned back after opening it, causing a continuity error.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the reaction force of the body bag on the player in [i]BodyBag[/i] to make it easier for the player to pass through.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the light-off effect sometimes failed in [i]DarkMover[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug in the [i]Cameras[/i] level where the sound never faded.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Updates:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the amplitude and frequency of camera shake, and modified the maximum acceleration of character movement to make the character's actions slightly clumsier.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a highlight display for the current progress in the progress panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the score panel to show total depth, changing from the original "1" to "1/3".[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the frequency band of UI sound effects, weakened the high-frequency part, and added a warning sound effect for UI pop-ups.[/p][/*][*][p]After the player chooses a door, there will be clear sound prompts (correct/incorrect).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the level order, placing more difficult levels in the second loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the volume of the [i]Eyes[/i] event to make anomalies easier to detect.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some levels with relatively hidden anomalies to make them easier to find.[/p][/*][*][p]Added localized content for the rabbit doll's voice.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a light refraction material to invisible enemies to improve their visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly adjusted the layout of the loop space to place the prompt panel.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Additions:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added an opening prompt: "Wearing headphones for a better experience".[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hint system that will provide prompts when the player makes repeated mistakes in a certain level.[/p][/*][*][p]Added warnings for players with heart disease or hypertension.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "boredom button" during compilation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a manual panel next to the progress panel to clarify the game rules.[/p][/*][/list]
